examples.en: Nowadays, few people like to study meteorology.
examples.zh: 现在，很少有人愿意学气象学。

words.memory: meteor(高处的事物) + logy(学说) → 气象学。

examples.en: The weather is mild today; it is neither hot nor cold.
examples.zh: 今天的天气温暖舒适，不热也不冷。

collocation: a mild climate 温和的气候

examples.en: The workers are installing a heating system.
examples.zh: 工人们正在安装供暖系统。

collocation: central heating 中央暖气系统
words.memory: heat n. 热；强烈感情 v. (使)变热

examples.en: The wind was strong all day, but it moderated in the evening.
examples.zh: 一整天，风都刮得很厉害，但到傍晚时有所减弱了。

collocation: a moderate climate 温和的气候

examples.en: The blood of a warm-blooded animal remains around the same temperature both on warm and cold days.
examples.zh: 不论天气温暖还是寒冷，恒温动物的血都会保持基本不变的温度。

examples.en: The thermal energy has become more and more important.
examples.zh: 热能变得越来越重要了。

examples.en: He lives in the tropics.
examples.zh: 他住在热带地区。

collocation: in the tropics 在热带地区

examples.en: It is difficult to grow fruit in arid desert areas.
examples.zh: 在干燥的沙漠地带栽培水果很困难。

collocation: an arid desert 干旱的荒漠

examples.en: His eyes were moist with tears.
examples.zh: 泪水润湿了他的眼睛。

examples.en: The damp match won't strike.
examples.zh: 这潮湿的火柴划不着。

collocation: a damp climate 潮湿的气候

examples.en: The milk powder has lumped together because my home is so humid.
examples.zh: 我家太潮湿了，所以奶粉结块了。

collocation: humid conditions 湿热的天气状况

examples.en: The snowy weather lasted the whole time we were there.
examples.zh: 我们在那儿的整段时间都是下雪的天气。

examples.en: Sweet potatoes decayed after the frost.
examples.zh: 发生霜冻之后，甘薯烂掉了。

examples.en: It hailed during the night.
examples.zh: 夜间下了冰雹。

examples.en: The sun thawed the ice and melted the snow.
examples.zh: 阳光之下，冰雪消融。

collocation: thaw (sth.) out (使冷冻食品)解冻；(使某物)变暖

examples.en: The bad news cast a chill over the whole family.
examples.zh: 这坏消息使全家人感到不寒而栗。

collocation: chill enthusiasm 使热情冷却

examples.en: The weatherman predicted a freeze for tonight.
examples.zh: 天气预报员预报今晚有霜冻。

examples.en: Hohhot is a frigid city in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天的呼和浩特十分寒冷。

collocation: the frigid zones 寒带
a frigid climate 极冷的气候

examples.en: There was a tremble in her voice.
examples.zh: 她的声音颤抖着。

collocation: tremble all over 浑身颤抖

examples.en: She shivered because she was worried and afraid.
examples.zh: 她因担忧和害怕而发抖。

collocation: shiver with cold 冷得发抖
words.memory: 以er结尾的词，常常表示一种反复状态，如：batter(连续用bat[球棒]击打→连续猛击)，chatter(反复chat[聊天]→喋喋不休)，flicker(摇曳，闪烁不定)，teeter(蹒跚行走；摇摇欲坠)，teeter-totter(反复出现摇摇欲坠的状态→跷跷板)。

meanings.cn: 打雷；轰隆隆地快速移动

examples.en: An express train thundered through the station.
examples.zh: 一辆快车轰隆隆地驶过车站。

examples.en: During the storm, flashes of lightning appeared in the sky.
examples.zh: 暴风雨中，道道闪电划过天空。

meanings.cn: 有暴风雨的；争吵激烈的；(大海)波涛汹涌的

examples.en: Our ship was tossed about on the stormy sea.
examples.zh: 我们的船在波涛汹涌的海面上颠簸。

examples.en: For the past six hours, the downpour had been continuous.
examples.zh: 过去的六个小时里，倾盆大雨持续不断。

words.memory: down(向下) + pour(倾倒) → 倾盆大雨。

examples.en: There have been four years of below-average rainfall.
examples.zh: 已经有四年降雨量低于平均值了。

words.memory: rain(雨) + fall(降落) → 降雨量。

examples.en: We've only had a few sprinkles of rain recently.
examples.zh: 近来，我们这里只下过几场小雨。

collocation: sprinkle sth. on sth. 把某物洒/撒到某物上

examples.en: A rainbow is usually seen after a heavy rain.
examples.zh: 彩虹通常在大雨之后出现。

examples.en: The weatherman predicts showers this afternoon.
examples.zh: 气象预报员预报今天下午有阵雨。

examples.en: The maximum temperature in July may be 36 degrees Celsius.
examples.zh: 7月的最高温度可能达到36摄氏度。

words.memory:
Fahrenheit adj. 华氏的 n. 华氏温度
以摄氏温标最初的提出者，即18世纪的瑞典科学家Anders Celsius的名字命名。

examples.en: After the storm, there will be a sharp drop in temperature.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，气温将骤降。

collocation: take the temperature 量温度

examples.en: The recent statement of the president forecasts a change in the situation.
examples.zh: 总统最近的一次讲话预示着形势将有所变化。

words.memory: fore(前，先) + cast(扔) → 预先扔下 → 预报。

examples.en: The mountain peaks are covered with snow all year round.
examples.zh: 山峰上终年覆盖着雪。

collocation: a mountain peak 山峰

examples.en: The old lady can only mount the stairs with difficulty.
examples.zh: 这位老妇人上楼梯十分艰难。

examples.en: The northern side of the mountain is almost vertical.
examples.zh: 这座山的北坡几乎是垂直的。

examples.en: A range of hills rose on our left.
examples.zh: 山脉在我们左方出现。

collocation: in the range of 在……范围内；在……射程内

examples.en: The sky above the ridge of the mountains brightened.
examples.zh: 山脊上方的天空变得明亮起来。

examples.en: He ran up the slope to the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 他跑上斜坡，来到山顶。

examples.en: The valley was hidden from view in the mist.
examples.zh: 溪谷隐没在雾霾之中，看不见了。

collocation: in a valley 在山谷里

examples.en: The path steepened as they climbed the hillside.
examples.zh: 他们顺着山坡往上爬，小径愈发陡峭。

examples.en: The house on the hill overlooks the village.
examples.zh: 从小山上的房子可以俯瞰村庄。

collocation: be easily overlooked 容易被忽略的
words.memory: over(在上) + look(看) → 在上面往下看 → 俯瞰。

examples.en: Only in the southern part of Taiwan have I seen such scenery.
examples.zh: 唯有在台湾南部我才见过这样的风景。

examples.en: Austria lies to the southeast of Germany.
examples.zh: 奥地利在德国的东南边。

examples.en: Ireland is in the southwest of the British Isles.
examples.zh: 爱尔兰在不列颠群岛的西南部。

examples.en: Snow in October is nothing strange in northeast China.
examples.zh: 在中国东北部，10月下雪不是什么奇怪的事。

examples.en: There is a large hilly area in the northwest.
examples.zh: 西北部有一大片丘陵地带。

examples.en: The eastern situation is similarly intense.
examples.zh: 东部的情况同样紧张。

meanings.cn: 东方的(尤指中国和日本的)

examples.en: She has studied the cultures of oriental countries.
examples.zh: 她研究过东方各国的文化。

words.memory: 字根ori意为“升起”→太阳升起的地方→东方的。同字根的又如：origin(太阳升起的地方→起源)，originator(发起人)，orient(太阳升起的地方→东方→向东→确定方向)。在英美等地的一些大学，在新学年开始前后有一周叫O-Week，即Orientation Week，会给新生介绍大学的各种情况，让他们摸清方向，尽快适应。

examples.en: Such a difficult operation may not succeed, but it's an inevitable gamble.
examples.zh: 难度如此之大的手术可能会失败，但我们必须冒险一试。

words.memory: in(不) + evitable(可避免的) → 不可避免的。

meanings.cn: 不可逆转的；不可挽回的

examples.en: He suffered irreversible brain damage from the incident.
examples.zh: 他的大脑在事故中受伤，无法治愈。

words.memory: ir(不) + re(回) + vers(转) + ible(可……的) → 不可以转回来的 → 不可逆转的。

examples.en: The patient is breathing irregularly.
examples.zh: 病人的呼吸很不均匀。

examples.en: Your bright red coat would be quite inappropriate for a funeral.
examples.zh: 你鲜艳的红大衣很不适合葬礼。

meanings.cn: 不正常的，反常的；变态的

examples.en: El Niño will result in the abnormal weather.
examples.zh: 厄尔尼诺现象将会导致异常的天气。

collocation: an abnormal climate 异常气候
words.memory: ab(不) + normal(正常的) → 不正常的。

examples.en: The sediment of coffee will settle.
examples.zh: 咖啡渣会沉淀下去。

examples.en: River sediments gradually silted up the harbour.
examples.zh: 河流的沉积物逐渐使港口淤塞。

examples.en: We left the car and struck out along the muddy track.
examples.zh: 我们下了车，开始沿着泥泞的小路前行。

examples.en: Bricks and dishes are made from various kinds of clay.
examples.zh: 砖和盘子由各种黏土制成。

examples.en: The children were outside, playing happily in the dirt.
examples.zh: 孩子们正在外面的泥土地里开心地玩耍。

examples.en: The disease occurs most frequently in rural areas.
examples.zh: 那种疾病多见于农村地区。

collocation: rural areas 农村地区

examples.en: They proposed setting up a school in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 他们建议在郊区成立一所学校。

words.memory: sub(接近) + urb(城市) → 城市附近。

examples.en: We live on the outskirts of the city.
examples.zh: 我们住在这座城市的郊区。

examples.en: She came from a remote village.
examples.zh: 她来自一个偏僻的村子。

collocation: a remote control 遥控器

examples.en: So how should they escape from these desolate canyons?
examples.zh: 那么他们要怎样逃出这些荒凉的峡谷呢？

examples.en: It snows all year round in that distant little village.
examples.zh: 那个遥远的小村落整年下雪。

collocation: the distant past 遥远的过去

examples.en: We stayed in adjacent rooms.
examples.zh: 我们待在相邻的房间。

collocation: adjacent to 与……毗连的

examples.en: All medicines are toxic.
examples.zh: 所有药物都有毒性。

collocation: toxic waste 有毒废物
highly toxic 剧毒的
words.memory: 来源于希腊语toxon，意为“弓(bow)”，在荷马史诗《伊利亚特》中还能寻到其踪迹。后来在战争中，人们普遍在箭头上涂毒药，提高弓箭的杀伤力，字根tox就有了“毒”的含义。如：toxicant(毒物，毒药)，detoxify(解毒)，toxicologist(毒理学家)，intoxicated(心里中毒的→陶醉的)。

examples.en: Waste water from the factory is the main cause of pollution in local rivers.
examples.zh: 来自那家工厂的污水是造成当地河流污染的主要原因。

collocation: pollution control 污染控制

examples.en: Coal is a heavy pollutant.
examples.zh: 煤是一种重污染物。

collocation: atmospheric pollutants 大气污染物

examples.en: The river was contaminated with waste.
examples.zh: 这条河被垃圾污染了。

collocation: contaminated water 受到污染的水
words.memory: con(共同) + tam(接触) + in(里面) + ate(动词后缀) → 大家一起在里面摸来摸去 → 污染。

examples.en: He devoted all his life to the research of the agricultural geology.
examples.zh: 他把一生奉献给了农业地质学的研究事业。

examples.en: The border incident lead to the war between the two countries.
examples.zh: 这一边境事件导致了两国交战。

collocation: within the borders of 在……境内

examples.en: There is no margin for error in our plan.
examples.zh: 我们的计划不容有误。

collocation: allow a greater margin of 允许有更大的……余地

examples.en: We feel it's pretty good and we also offer some good fringe benefits.
examples.zh: 我们觉得这很不错，而且我们还提供一些很好的附加福利。

examples.en: It is generally accepted that earthquakes are caused by two tectonic plates bumping into each other.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为，地震是由两块构造板块互相碰撞造成的。

examples.en: We are searching for his corpse among the debris after the explosion.
examples.zh: 爆炸后，我在瓦砾堆中寻找着他的尸体。

examples.en: The door opened just a crack.
examples.zh: 这扇门只打开一条缝。

collocation: cause a crack 弄出裂缝

examples.en: There are wide gaps in my knowledge of history.
examples.zh: 我的历史知识很贫乏。

collocation: the generation gap 代沟

examples.en: You're all doing a splendid job; keep up the good work!
examples.zh: 你们干得都很出色，要坚持下去！

collocation: a splendid chance 极好的机会

meanings.cn: 宏大的；豪华的，宏伟的；极好的

examples.en: He was born in the purple and was brought up in the grand palace.
examples.zh: 他出身于皇族，在宏伟的宫殿中长大。

meanings.cn: 壮丽的，宏伟的；令人印象深刻的

examples.en: The king lived in this magnificent palace.
examples.zh: 国王住在这座宏伟的宫殿里。

examples.en: I've discovered a super restaurant near here!
examples.zh: 我在附近发现一家超级棒的餐馆！

examples.en: There is an interesting programme on television tonight.
examples.zh: 今天晚上有一档有趣的电视节目。

derivatives.cn: 感兴趣的；有利害关系的

examples.en: She made a dramatic speech at the meeting.
examples.zh: 她在会上发表了激动人心的演说。

collocation: a dramatic event 令人印象深刻的事件

examples.en: From his attic window, he looked out over a beautiful wilderness.
examples.zh: 从阁楼的窗户望去，他看到一片美丽的荒野。

collocation: a wilderness area 保留自然环境面貌的地区

examples.en: The baby's mother deserted him soon after giving birth.
examples.zh: 那个母亲生下他后不久就把他遗弃了。

collocation: a cultural desert 文化沙漠
words.memory: 注意与dessert(n. [餐后]甜点，甜食)区分。

examples.en: The land is severely eroded as a result of widespread deforesting and intensive farming.
examples.zh: 土地因乱砍滥伐和密集耕种而受到严重侵蚀。

meanings.cn: 贫瘠的，荒芜的；不结果实的

examples.en: That remote barren land has blossomed into rich granaries.
examples.zh: 过去的穷乡僻壤变成了富饶的谷仓。

collocation: a barren desert 荒漠
words.memory: 知名组合“男孩地带”(Boyzone)有一首经典歌曲No Matter What，其中一段歌词为“No matter where it's barren, a dream is being born”，即“不论是什么荒芜的地方，都有梦在诞生”。

examples.en: There's enough to transform barren coral atolls into fertile groves.
examples.zh: 这足以将贫瘠的环礁变成富饶的丛林。

examples.en: I fertilised the lawn and pulled out the weeds.
examples.zh: 我为草坪施了肥又除了杂草。

words.memory: = fertilize

examples.en: This toy is operated by solar energy.
examples.zh: 这个玩具是太阳能驱动的。

collocation: solar system 太阳系
solar energy 太阳能
words.memory: 来自拉丁语sol，意为“太阳”。ar是形容词后缀。

examples.en: All traditional Chinese festivals are lunar calendar festivals.
examples.zh: 中国传统节日的时间都是按照阴历定的。

collocation: a lunar eclipse 月食
words.memory: 来自拉丁语luna，意为“月亮”。

examples.en: The Islamic calendar has fewer days than the Gregorian calendar.
examples.zh: 伊斯兰历比公历的天数少。

collocation: lunar calendar 阴历

examples.en: The beauty of the sunrise is beyond description.
examples.zh: 日出的美景难以描述。

collocation: at sunrise 日出时

examples.en: By sunset we had covered thirty miles.
examples.zh: 到日落的时候，我们已走了30英里。

collocation: at sunset 日落时
a sunset industry 夕阳产业(逐渐没落的产业)
sunset glow 晚霞

examples.en: It will take about an hour to reach full eclipse stage.
examples.zh: 要历时大约一个小时才能进入全食阶段。

collocation: a solar/lunar eclipse 日/月食

examples.en: The street lights go on at dusk.
examples.zh: 街灯在黄昏时亮起来。

collocation: by dusk 到黄昏时

meanings.cn: 天堂；极乐(之地)；[the ~s] 天空

examples.en: Our week on the tropical island was heaven.
examples.zh: 我们在那座热带小岛上待了一周，简直太开心了。

examples.en: This club is a sportsman's paradise.
examples.zh: 这个俱乐部是运动爱好者的乐园。

examples.en: I was sitting in the garden, enjoying the sunshine.
examples.zh: 我坐在庭院里，享受着阳光。

collocation: be bathed in sunshine 沐浴在阳光中

examples.en: He tried to shade his house with thick trees.
examples.zh: 他试图用茂密的树木给房子遮阳。

collocation: provide shade 提供阴凉处

examples.en: The willow's shadow falls on the lake.
examples.zh: 垂柳的影子投在湖面上。

collocation: cast a shadow 投下阴影

examples.en: When water changes to water vapour, we say it evaporates.
examples.zh: 当水变成水蒸气时，我们就称水蒸发了。

words.memory: = vapor

examples.en: The pool of water on the playground evaporated in the sun.
examples.zh: 操场上的那摊水在阳光下蒸发了。

examples.en: Circulating blood helps transfer the body heat out to the air.
examples.zh: 循环的血液会促进体内的热量散到体外。

examples.en: Clouds usually precipitate as rain or snow.
examples.zh: 云常会凝结成雨或雪。

examples.en: This reservoir gives water to the whole city.
examples.zh: 这座水库为全城提供用水。

examples.en: They were filled with wonder at the new waterfall.
examples.zh: 他们对新瀑布感到非常惊奇。

examples.en: Social life is the fountain of wisdom for writers.
examples.zh: 社会生活是作家们智慧的源泉。

examples.en: It can be quite windy there, especially in spring.
examples.zh: 那里的天气相当多风，特别是在春季。

examples.en: Dew dripped from the leaves.
examples.zh: 露水从叶子上滴下来。

examples.en: Tears poured from her eyes.
examples.zh: 泪水从她眼中涌出。

examples.en: They drain the swamp and turn it into fertile land.
examples.zh: 他们排干沼泽地的水，将它变成了肥沃的土地。

words.memory: 词源同dry(adj. 干的)。
